invalidInput: Check input identifiers and labels in {node}: duplicates, empty labels or invalid lengths.
referencedInputKey: Instructions reference this identifier. Update instructions before renaming it.
sourceNotice: Use the project's goal and method as a reference. Define your own inputs, steps and deliverable. This does not execute external code or publish anything.
title: Workflow name
slugHint: 3–64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.
costHint: Reference for legacy billing. Actual charges follow platform billing and the selected model.
advancedHint: Maintain branches, mappings and special configurations. Both views preserve the original definition. Every step and connection is validated again before saving.
repairHint: This definition cannot be displayed completely. Fix the issues in advanced mode, then return to the visual editor.
dependenciesHint: Actual dependencies appear below each step. Branches remain intact.
recipeLocked: This recipe is maintained by the platform. Visual controls are read-only to preserve the generation contract. Advanced changes must still pass recipe validation.
promptHint: Use {input} for user input and {upstream} for a real upstream result. Input identifiers must match those below.
conditionHint: Maintain condition rules and branches in advanced JSON. All existing rules and connections are preserved.
inputHint: Collect information before running. No personal input is stored here.
noInputs: No explicit inputs for this step. Input placeholders in instructions are still detected automatically.
previewNotice: This defines presentation only; no generated result is simulated. JSON preview requires the model to return valid JSON.
privateNotice: Saved privately. Public publication requires review.
leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave the studio?
replaceConfirm: Replace the current definition with the platform recipe?
invalidJson: Cannot parse JSON. Check its syntax.
newPrompt: Process the following real content according to the requirements. Do not invent facts:
removeInputReference: Instructions still reference this input. Remove or update those references before deleting it.
advancedInsertion: This result has branches, custom mappings, grouped stages or has reached its step limit. Add steps and maintain dependencies in advanced JSON.
advancedRemoval: Other steps reference this step, or it has complex connections or output duties. Resolve dependencies in advanced JSON before deleting it.
validated: Definition validated. The current version will be validated again on save.
saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
savedVersion: Private version {version} saved. It can be submitted for review.
